objective: saves_per_reach: Create a seven-day Deepavali campaign for Poojaloka's diyas, brass items and pooja essentials across Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest and Threads, aimed at families in Bengaluru.
audience: Families in Bengaluru and across Karnataka preparing for daily pooja and festivals; people setting up a first home altar. (Suggested from the catalogue and site; confirm with real customer data.)

canva_query: Design a 1080×1350 (4:5 portrait) Instagram carousel cover for Poojaloka. Layout: two stacked colour blocks: headline above, tagline and CTA below. Colours #FBF3E7, #2B1810, #6B1420; mood: warm, respectful and uncluttered. Text, exactly as written: "Getting ready for Deepavali", "Plan your Deepavali pooja list with Poojaloka", "Start your list today", "Poojaloka". Use exactly the quoted text and add no other words, numbers, prices, offers or claims. Typographic only: no product photos, stock photos, deities, religious figures, mantras or Sanskrit text.
